description: Live bug: 'Check Now' on Georgia Wagner's 'Jonathan Hunt Thriller Series' admitted 'A Jonathan Hunt Thriller' -- no ISBN, no real subtitle, nothing but the series name plus a bare genre tagline -- as a new book. An earlier fix only caught this when the tracked series name itself already contained 'Thriller' (so the word cancelled out against the series name); it recurred once the series was tracked under the shorter name 'Jonathan Hunt', where 'thriller' no longer overlaps the series name and was treated as real, distinguishing content. Frozen from tests/test_series_discovery.py::DiscoveryEngineHelperTest::test_title_is_series_variant_rejects_bare_genre_tagline_regardless_of_series_wording.

cases.name: genre_word_alongside_genuine_additional_content_is_not_filler
cases.title: A Jonathan Hunt Thriller: The Reckoning
